﻿BLOXCLIPS CAMPAIGN
Huss Valley Clipping Guide
Make short videos that show off Huss Valley, a hunters vs runners party map in Fortnite, and get viewers to play it with the island code.
CPM
$2
	MAX PER VIDEO
$50
	BUDGET
$5,000
	

🎬Footage: [Click Here]
▶️Examples: [Click Here For Viral Formats] 
🎮Game: Huss Valley (4650-1603-2769)
Discord: BloxClips Discord (required to get paid)
	Campaign goal
Get viewers to play the map. The angle that sells it: it's tag with swords in Fortnite. Cross the field before the hunters knock you down, and if you get caught, you become a hunter. Show how fast it gets chaotic, then give viewers the island code.
How to structure your video
* Hook: give viewers a reason to keep watching in the first 2 seconds.
* Show the game: use the footage to back up what you're saying.
* CTA: tell viewers to play Huss Valley in Fortnite, with the island code 4650-1603-2769 and the island image on screen.
The concept, narration and editing are up to you, as long as the video clearly promotes the map and has the CTA.


HOOK IDEAS
Use these or come up with your own
* "The newest game on Roblox is now on Fortnite"
* "Get caught in this Fortnite map and you become the hunter"
* "Fortnite just got a brand new game"
* "Huss Valley is now on Fortnite"
* "Since when is Fortnite getting all the top games"
	What players can do
* Run across the field before time runs out. Get knocked down and a teammate can revive you.
* Hunt with a sword and knock runners down. Everyone you catch joins the hunters next round.
* Get picked and choose: run alone as the Hero, or run with everyone as the Chicken.
* Vote for the map: Classic, Football Field or Spooky Forest.
* Collect gold, open crates and unlock swords and abilities like Rocket Shoes and the Emergency Airhorn.
You don't need to show everything. Pick what fits your video.
Requirements
* Videos must be in English OR in a Tier 1 language (e.g. German, French). The video being in English means no 30% requirement. Non-English videos need at least 30% Tier 1 audience. 
* Stand out with your own footage. Videos built only from the shared clips are allowed but they don’t perform as well. Creating your own footage will lead to the most views
* Only Fortnite-focused accounts can upload. Do not upload from Roblox or ForgeGUI accounts.
* The video is about Huss Valley only.
* Say "Huss Valley" somewhere in the video.
* Show the island code 4650-1603-2769 and the island image (in the footage folder) on screen during the CTA.
* Present the map as out now and playable in Fortnite.
* Use the provided footage. You can also record and add your own Huss Valley gameplay.
* Keep at least a 1% engagement rate.
* Cross-posting to TikTok, Shorts and Reels is encouraged.
Posting
Use hashtags that help people find the map. Mix them up between posts:
#fortnitemaps #uefn #hussvalley #fortnite #fortnitecreative #gaming
	Your video will be rejected if
* It's posted on a Roblox or ForgeGUI account.
* The island code or island image is missing from the CTA.
* It's low effort, poorly presented, misleading or off-topic.
* It makes up features, rewards or codes that aren't in the map.
* It uses an AI thumbnail.
* Views or engagement are bought, botted or boosted. Botters are banned for good.
	



Whop Link: https://whop.com/bloxclips
